description: Screenshot of a September 14, 2020 tweet by former NSA official William Binney (@Bill_Binney, display name 'Bill Binney, Constitutional Patriot'). Binney claims that text messages deleted by the Mueller team could be recovered from the NSA's 'Stellarwind' database because all SMS traffic is captured and stored, tagging Devin Nunes and Fox News. The tweet embeds a YouTube card for a Fox News segment of Rep. Devin Nunes discussing reports that Mueller team members wiped their phones.
text: Bill Binney, Constitutional Patriot. @Bill_Binney. (15) Re Muller team deleting text msgs: This won't do. If gov wants those msgs, all they have to do is go to NSA Stellarwind data base and pull them out as all sms going over the cell network are captured & stored forever. @DevinNunes knows this. @FoxNews. Rep. Nunes on Mueller team wiping phones in the face of DOJ... Congressman Devin Nunes discusses the news that multiple members of Special Counsel Mueller's team wiped their phon... youtube.com. REP NUNES (R-CA): MUELLER TEAM WIPING IS DESTRUCTION OF FEDERAL RECOR. SUNDAY MORNING FUTURES. 6:41 PM · Sep 14, 2020 · Twitter Web App.
